title: Windy fleet version manifest, v1
$comment: ADR-060 §5 (the Steamroller). ONE document, published by admin (admin.windyword.ai/v1/fleet-versions), that every product's check_for_update resolves against. It answers, per product per channel: what is current, what is the minimum still-supported version, and where to get it. This is the SENDING half of updates — surfaces.json + a surface's own version tell you what's INSTALLED; this tells you what SHOULD be installed. An agent diffs the two to know what to offer to update.

generated_at.$comment: ISO-8601. Stamped by the publisher (admin), NOT by the Loom — the Loom is deterministic and has no clock.

doctrine.$comment: e.g. 'ADR-060 v1.0' — the doctrine version this product complies with.

channels.$comment: A product may ship on several channels (stable / beta / the Windy-0 canary ring). check_for_update names its channel.

minimum.$comment: below this = must-update (security/breaking); an agent should push, not merely offer.

kind.$comment: how it's distributed — the Steamroller rail (ADR-060 §5). npm packet, R2 desktop build, cloud image rebuild, or native (agent self-update).

source.$comment: the fetch handle: npm package name, downloads.<domain> URL, image ref, etc.

notes.$comment: grandma-English 'what this fixes' — the agent reads this aloud when offering the update.

rollout.$comment: staged rollout (ADR-060 §5): rings gate exposure. Absent = 100%.
